info.name: Payment Platform - Sandbox acceptance
info.description: Run folders in numerical order. Creates two fresh sandbox accounts and INR test funds. Never use against real money. Tokens and generated credentials stay in collection variables; clear them before exporting/sharing. Use the public frontend base URL, not private Cloud Run services. Read postman/README.md for manual operation, cold starts and safe retry instructions.

item.name: 01 - Register and login
item.description: Initialize fresh users once per new journey. A REGISTRATION_PENDING response can be resumed by resending that registration request unchanged, without rerunning Initialize.

item.name: Initialize fresh users - run once per full journey

request.description: Initialize fresh users - run once per full journey. Uses sandbox INR only. Mutation requests are never automatically retried.
